toolPolicy: One gltfpack 1.2 invocation at -si0.5/-se0.005, locked proxy borders, no quantization, no permissive/aggressive mode. Final mesh copies original attribute rows, rig/clips/materials and BIN prefix; optimizer attributes/animations are never admitted.
silhouettePolicy: Whole exact protected regions; torso/limb bounded-error index proposal. -se0.005 means relative 0.5%, not a 5mm guarantee. Final conversational/front/side RT contour/acting review is required; no blanket contour or UV seam locking.
provenance: Existing owner-supplied Meshy Warden; original source and runtime remain unchanged. Same asset-specific redistribution evidence in ASSET_LICENSES.md. No acquisition, generation service, paid operation or licence change.
limits: One optimizer invocation only, no repair/retuning loop.
Exact surviving attributes do not prove unchanged interpolated surface, texture/normal interpolation, acting or silhouette.
Original BIN remains as unused prefix for proof; file growth is audit overhead, not shipping savings.
No runtime/default asset/test/Git/build/device changes; no native, image, frame/GPU/phone acceptance claimed.
